newsitem.title: UK: UPS sees limited international impact from strike.
newsitem.headline: UPS sees limited international impact from strike.

text.p: United Parcel Service said that the strike by its Teamster employees was expected to have a limited impact on international traffic to the United States.
And such traffic "will receive top priority for delivery scheduling in the U.S.", UPS said in a statement issued by its Brussels-based European regional headquarters.

The strike began at 0400 GMT on Monday and the union represents nearly two-thirds of the company's 301,000 workers in the U.S., mainly those who sort and unload packages, haul shipments and drive the company's delivery vans.
The company said that it has contingency plans in place to maintain service levels in the U.S..
UPS added that: "Business in Europe was continuing as usual and its European and domestic services across Europe are unaffected by the strike in the U.S.."

The strike started after a last ditch effort to set a new five-year contract collapsed in Washington with the two sides far apart over union demands for stringer pensions, health and safety benefits, higher pay and restrictions on non-unionised sub-contractors.
The 2,000 unionised UPS pilots said they would remain off the job in sympathy with the walkout by the strikers. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
